title: Sherman #13 - HOOK v2 (re-voiced hook-1 + hook-2), hook-a atlanta_hd_ref hook-1..3, 0:00-0:20
note: Stakes 0-8.75 s; ONE continuous zoom lands on 'Atlanta.' at 8.2 s; number slams 9.3 s; the title's promise (breaks the Confederacy within a year) spoken + stamped at 13.9 s. hook-3 on: unchanged beats, shifted +2.4 s.
frames: Frame 0: theatre Aug 1864 (option 1), flags, legend; GRANT/LEE at Petersburg, 3 UNION ARMIES on ATLANTA
AUGUST 1864 stamp (0.3 s); STALLED (Petersburg); Lincoln badge (real photo) slides in
'expected to lose': Lincoln's memorandum card (verbatim, 23 Aug 1864)
'the election': the paper folds shut, sealed note + paste seal
'the Union with it': SIGNED UNREAD · BY HIS CABINET; the W&A glows Chattanooga -> Atlanta
'Everything hung': gold ring on Atlanta; ONE continuous zoom starts (6.6 s)
Mid-zoom: south map fading, atlanta map fading in (feathered, same camera, no cut)
Lands on 'Atlanta.' (8.2 s): atlanta map, railroads, Union corps on the siege lines
'Nearly a hundred thousand': BIG card slams (9.3 s), ticks to 98,797 UNION SOLDIERS
Ticks done (98,797); front + red fort ring round the city
'one general' (? badge slides in, 12.4 s); 'break the Confederacy': BREAKS THE CONFEDERACY · WITHIN A YEAR
'At the end of August': the promise stamp clears; the siege holds
'four months': 4 MONTHS stamp (then STILL HOLDING at 19.8 s)
